answer.summary: The prose quality benefits from manual writing, but the core improvements follow repeatable state-first moves: identify the audited surface, separate related or external surfaces, centralize uncertainty, bind claims to evidence, and suppress overreach by pressure subtype.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: State the governing uncertainty once before dimension findings.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Could become boilerplate if too templated.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Name the audited surface as the primary evidence anchor.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Unsafe if target/entity metadata is missing or wrong.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Describe related surfaces as pressure/context, not aliases or ownership.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Requires explicit relation_type metadata; unsafe from URLs alone.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Treat owned claims as positioning unless external corroboration exists.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Can become repetitive if every finding restates it.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Mark findings without evidence URLs as limited rather than turning them into weakness.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: May understate useful findings if source extraction is incomplete.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Explicitly list what the candidate did not infer.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Can sound like meta-disclaimer if rendered directly in reports.

repeatable_prose_moves.description: Apply the same global uncertainty differently by dimension.
repeatable_prose_moves.risk: Requires dimension-aware phrasing; generic templates would regress.

moves: do not treat similarly named domains as aliases
separate perceptual visibility from evidentiary ownership
withhold AI/open-source vitality from audited design surface
separate owned site, adjacent domains, repositories, marketplace listings and unrelated mentions
avoid traction inference from marketplace presence
demote weak support claims rather than rewriting the case

conditions: related surfaces include reviewed relation types
repository and marketplace surfaces are marked as such
ownership and roadmap inference are blocked
entity boundary and related-surface pressure are inactive
needs Netlify-style prose candidate before implementation confidence
needs Builtwith-style prose candidate before implementation confidence

must_remain_human_written_or_review_gate: category leadership or market position claims
visual/perceptual interpretation beyond explicit surface signals
unsafe_automation_zones: using visual confidence as evidence confidence
turning missing evidence into a negative finding
writing a stronger narrative than the evidence map supports
applying strong mode to stable cases to justify the system

recommendation.rationale: The candidates show enough repeatable structure to justify a constrained lab-only generator, provided it generates candidates with explicit evidence boundaries and keeps high-risk fields review-gated.
required_before_runtime: automated outputs must be compared against manual candidates
Netlify and Builtwith should be tested before any production discussion
human review should remain required for strong-mode ambiguity cases
no official report replacement until generated prose beats baseline without hiding uncertainty

required_guardrails: generator must abstain when audited surface is unknown
generator must not infer related surfaces from arbitrary evidence URLs
strong mode must keep requires_human_review true
light mode must not invent ambiguity
every dimension candidate must include evidence_used or missing_evidence_note
every dimension candidate must include uncertainty_retained
every dimension candidate must include overreach_avoided
generated prose must not contain generic Decision Space language
generated prose must not use scores as evidence
generated prose must not claim production readiness
